trends.name: Iran-US Military Escalation & Strait Risks
trends.summary: Iran war enters fifth week with NATO intercepting fourth Iranian missile over Turkey, US deploys hundreds of special ops including Navy SEALs to Middle East, and Iranian officials reject US diplomatic overtures as 'excessive & illogical.' Rubio outlines explicit military objectives including destruction of Iranian air force, navy, and missile capabilities. Critical risk: Strait of Hormuz closure threatens global oil supply and already driving commodity inflation.

trends.name: Oil Price Surge & Energy Sector Momentum
trends.summary: Brent crude heads for record monthly surge above $103/barrel on Iran war; US Energy Select Sector Index achieves 14-week consecutive gain streak (longest on record) with +43% rally. Energy stocks fueled by geopolitical risk premium and investor rotation out of AI/software. Powell dismisses need for rate hikes despite oil shock, signaling inflation concerns may be contained.

trends.name: CTA Systematic Selling Exhaustion Signal
trends.summary: Commodity Trading Advisors (algorithm-driven trend-following funds) have sold $85 billion in US equities over last 30 trading days—the largest monthly sale on record. Exhaustion of systematic selling may suggest washout bottom and potential reversal setup for equity buyers. Critical technical signal of market capitulation.

trends.name: Micron & AI Semiconductor Volatility
trends.summary: Micron presents dip-buying opportunity amid momentum fatigue. Reports emerge that Sam Altman's 40% global DRAM supply orders may be non-binding and uncertain due to Stargate project delays, creating uncertainty in semiconductor demand forecasts. Energy sector rotation away from AI/software stocks weighing on chip valuations.

trends.name: Meta Stock Upside & Tech Valuation Shift
trends.summary: Morgan Stanley identifies 45% upside potential for Meta as AI/software rotation reverses. Signals investor positioning shift back into mega-cap tech after weeks of systematic selling and energy sector outperformance. Sentiment indicator of potential re-rating in growth stocks.

trends.name: Supply Chain & China Tariff Inflation Fears
trends.summary: Chinese suppliers warn of higher prices for Americans due to Strait of Hormuz closure disrupting shipping routes. Combined with geopolitical risk, creates dual inflationary pressure: energy costs + supply chain disruption. Airlines like JetBlue already raising bag fees in response to fuel cost surge.

trends.name: Fed Rate Outlook & Inflation Expectations
trends.summary: Powell signals inflation expectations remain 'well anchored' and sees no need for rate hikes despite oil shock, suggesting current range is appropriate. However, inflation breakeven expectations data shows some anchoring concerns. Fed indicated rates could move higher or lower depending on economic data—policy remains data-dependent.

trends.name: Student Loan Repayment Plan Deadline
trends.summary: 7+ million borrowers face deadline to exit Biden-era repayment plan, creating consumer cash flow uncertainty. Potential income compression for households as payment schedules resume or switch, rippling through discretionary spending and consumer stocks. Policy shift materially impacts household finances.

trends.name: Cybersecurity Stock Rebound After Selloff
trends.summary: Cybersecurity stocks rebounding sharply after recent sell-offs, with Palo Alto Networks and peers noted as standout gainers. Suggests technical reversal after oversold conditions and renewed institutional buying. Sector valuation reset attracts value-oriented investors.

trends.name: Private Credit Systemic Risk Concerns
trends.summary: Barclays disputes private credit systemic risk label, but counter-argument notes canary signals: large funds closing doors after markets elevated from well-documented complacency. Liquidity concerns in private credit universe warrant monitoring—not technical risk but operational cliff risk if gates close.

trends.name: Shipping & Logistics Crisis From Iran War
trends.summary: Iran war directly impacting global shipping carriers; FlexiVan Leasing CEO notes operational strain on freight logistics. Strait of Hormuz closure forces ships to reroute, increasing transit times and costs. Ripple effects across supply chains and inflation expectations.

trends.name: Nuclear Energy Funding & Clean Tech Boom
trends.summary: Billions in nuclear energy funding dollars targeting deployment and infrastructure buildout, driven by AI data center power demands and decarbonization mandates. Capital allocation shift favors nuclear power utilities and related contractors. Long-term energy infrastructure play supporting both climate and AI growth narratives.
